body: There is a PR for this already, but no feedback yet: https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/pull/654

@rhysd hi hi! Would you be able to review #654 and create a release with the feature? At the moment we are suppressing this error explicitly but the PR introduces validation for the combination of `queue` and `cancel-in-progress`.
In case it's helpful to anyone needing a temporary workaround, you can do something like this: https://github.com/Expensify/GitHub-Actions/pull/101/changes

<!-- LCV-407-actionlint-queue-20261015 -->

Confirmed on Windows x64 on 2026-10-15 with the current official release, v1.7.12. WinGet reports that no newer package is available, and the repository's latest-release endpoint also returns v1.7.12.

Version output:

```text
1.7.12
installed by downloading from release page
built with go1.26.1 compiler for windows/amd64
```

Minimal reproduction:

```yaml
name: Queue syntax reproduction
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: queue-syntax-reproduction
  queue: max
jobs:
  example:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Queue syntax reproduction"
```

Running `actionlint -no-color queue-max-reproduction.yml` exits with code 1. The diagnostic is:

```text
unexpected key "queue" for "concurrency" section. expected one of "cancel-in-progress", "group" [syntax-check]
  |
7 |   queue: max
  |   ^~~~~~
```

GitHub's current official documentation explicitly supports this property for queueing pending workflow runs: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/write-workflows/choose-when-workflows-run/control-workflow-concurrency#example-queueing-multiple-pending-runs . The reproduction does not combine it with `cancel-in-progress: true`.

Could the maintainers review the existing fix in #654 and include support in an official release? Adding this reproduction here to preserve the existing issue rather than open a duplicate.
